authority: EXPERIMENTAL / NOT CANONICAL / NO PARAMETER PROMOTED / NO BLOCKER RETIRED

actual_margin.basis: home score minus away score, signed from the designated home team's perspective because venue is BLOCKED.

event_time.basis: startTimeEpoch, a Unix instant, rendered UTC. Source-scheduled start, not an observed kickoff; the distinction is recorded in the chronology report and never smoothed over.

expected_margin.basis: Model output, and doubly blocked: the rating-to-margin transform it would be expressed through is itself unratified.

game_id.basis: NCAA gameID namespaced by season: NCAA-<season>-<gameID>.

game_result.basis: W/L/T from the subject team's margin.

game_type.basis: contestName and bracketRound are blank on every retrieved row. The feed carries no postseason games at all, so regular season and conference championships are present and indistinguishable.

games_played_to_date.basis: Walk-forward countable from the corpus. Still absent from the governed allowlist, so not emitted and no ruling is claimed.

model_version.basis: No model produced these rows; they are observations.

observed_at.basis: No per-row observability instant. The payload's updated_at carries no zone and the HTTP Last-Modified header is a CDN stamp identical across every season.

opponent.basis: NCAA-designated away side, resolved the same way.

opponent_division.basis: Determined by fbs/fcs feed intersection. Used to exclude cross-division games; not emitted.

overtime_periods.basis: finalMessage carries FINAL (OT) through FINAL (4OT). Counted in the reports; not admitted, because availability is not admission.

pregame_team_rating.basis: Model output. No V3 run produced a pregame rating for these games.

prior_rating_state.basis: Model output. No V3 week-open state was ever serialised for these games.

recorded_at.basis: UTC instant the raw file was retrieved, from the acquisition manifest.

season.basis: Season path segment of the source URL.

source_provenance.basis: Source authority and the exact URL the row was retrieved from.

subsequent_outcomes.basis: Reconstructible from the corpus by derive_subsequent_outcomes, which orders each team's games by event_time. Not emitted: a denormalised copy of facts already in the corpus is a second place for them to be wrong.

team.basis: NCAA-designated home side resolved to a canonical schedule_id through the 2026 canonical master.

venue.basis: The feed designates home and away but publishes no neutral-site indicator, and none was found on any NCAA endpoint. Emitting HOME for every designated home team would assert that no game was played at a neutral site.

week.basis: Week path segment of the source URL.

source_report.overtime_disposition: finalMessage carries FINAL (OT) through FINAL (4OT), so the count is observable. overtime_periods is not on the governed allowlist, so it is reported and not emitted.
